task.title: Check for Red Hat service outages
task.shortdesc: You can access the Red Hat status page from the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console help panel to find information about the current and past status of console services and other Red Hat web sites.

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud Console, click the Help button to open the help panel, then click Red Hat status page. The Red Hat statusHybrid Cloud Console, click the Help button to open the help panel, then click Red Hat status page. The Red Hat status page opens in a new browser tab.
On the Red Hat status page, scroll down and click https://console.openshiftusgov.comhttps://console.openshiftusgov.com to expand the list of services and check for any outages.
Optional: Perform any of the following tasks:

ul.li: Click Subscribe to updates and enter your preferred contact information to receive notifications whenever Red Hat creates, updates, or resolves an incident.
Under Past incidents, review recent past outages and other incidents.
Click Incident history to view incidents from the previous three months.
